claim: For every pair of integers \(m,n\ge 2\), if \(F_2(K_{m,n})\) is the 2-token graph of the complete bipartite graph \(K_{m,n}\), then its Laplacian spectral radius is exactly \[\rho_L(F_2(K_{m,n}))=2(m+n-1).\] Thus the lower bound \(2(m+n-1)\) from the recent token-graph spectral-radius literature is sharp for every nonstar complete bipartite graph, not only for the balanced case.
integrity: The proof is self-contained. Finite computation is used only as a stress test, not as evidence for the infinite quantifier.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the 2-token graph and the Laplacian spectral radius.
The full Laplacian spectrum and token numbers \(k\ge3\) are not determined.
An older equivalent statement under double-vertex or symmetric-square terminology remains a residual literature risk.
title: Exact Laplacian spectral radius of 2-token complete bipartite graphs
